entities.summary: Goga Ashkenazi is a Kazakh businesswoman and socialite. She is the founder and CEO of MunaiGaz Engineering Group, a Kazakh oil and gas conglomerate. From 2012 to 2023, she was head of the fashion label Vionnet, based in Milan.
